verdict.rationale: A live probe found llms.txt at docs.getunleash.io with an 'Instructions for AI Agents' section, which says clean Markdown of any page is available by appending `.md`. That is corroborated by the many docs pages retrieved as .md URLs, so agents can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
